notes: Year of the deadline is not stated on the page (DAAD edition 2026/2027, applicants from all countries); 2027 chosen as the next occurrence after today. THA page lists languages 'German, English' but says the programme is generally taught in English. Tuition 'None' is page-wide, not explicitly 'for non-EU students'. uni-assist is mentioned only for certificate evaluation (VPD), not as the application channel (application via HISinOne), so applicationChannel omitted. OMITTED: intakes (no page states the year of the deadline, only day and month; verifier requires the year; expected next deadline is 15 July 2027 per DAAD 2026/2027 edition). OMITTED: tuition 0 (DAAD says Tuition fees per semester None, but no page quote with explicit wording like no tuition fees was found). THA REQUIREMENTS: official pages used: THA programme page (FAQ and 'Your Application') and DAAD 7126. The page does not say whether a Moroccan Bac alone gives direct access or Studienkolleg/Feststellungsprüfung is needed: only that foreign diplomas need a VPD (uni-assist or Bavarian recognition office), which decides this. English B2 is required per the THA FAQ, but DAAD says 'B2 required/recommended, no proof required' (certificates only give bonus points in the aptitude assessment), so certificateRequired=false. The FAQ lists an essay and bonus points under the heading 'International Business Informatics', which looks like a copy-paste from another programme; the aptitude test itself is stated for International Information Systems.
